infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses the camera to scan product barcodes, take product photos, and capture user profile pictures for shop setup.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photo library to upload product photos and attach receipts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to save downloaded PDF invoices and images to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use Face ID for quick and secure login.
